text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a rolling drain + reboot for az-east1-rack-7 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC for thermal recalibration and PSU balancing. We'll do 1 rack at a time, ~15m drain + 10m validation each. Canary traffic and cache-warm before each > ask oncall sign-off.

ashok: What is the capacity hit? will Dedicated pools be touched?

maria: Expected capacity hit ~7% for hosted pools during each rack drain. Dedicated pools will be excluded unless we hit backfill pressure (we'll avoid touching reserved capacity).

tess: For canary — how many requests and which routes? I can run smoke after each rack.

maria: Canary: 500 qps synthetic to /v1/completions (20% of normal canary), plus 50 concurrent embedding seeds. Routes: completion, chat, embeddings. We'll validate latency P95 and error rate <0.5%.

liam: FYI cost tradeoff: if we pre-warm KV/prefix cache we pay a bit of egress/compute but avoid tail latency spikes (worth it for hosted API). Propose to run cache seed + small burst capacity.

kai: Drain command I'll use (ops runbook snippet):
```
kubectl drain node/az-east1-rack7-node-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=900s
redwoodctl cache seed --prefix=\"az-east1/rack7\" --concurrency=8 --timeout=600s
```
Run tests after cache seed completes.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MNT-2026-1432 — window 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC, owner: maria. Automatic alert scheduled for 01:45 UTC.

oncall-night: Heads-up — customer ACME has a scheduled large training job 02:30-03:15 UTC in az-east1. Can we shift later or skip the rack that hosts their quota?

maria: Thanks — can we shift +1h? Propose new window 03:45-05:45 UTC to avoid the job. If ACME can't move we will exclude racks hosting their reserved nodes.

ashok: Prefer excluding reserved nodes. Also recommend we disable autoscaler-scaleouts during drain to avoid noisy provisioning.

tess: I'll own smoke runs. Smoke checklist: 1) quick /health on 10 hosts, 2) run 100 completions, 3) run embedding sample set, 4) check prefix cache hitrate >80% via telemetry query. I'll post results in the thread.

liam: Rollback plan: if errors >1% or P95 > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive canaries, we abort and execute: `redwoodctl routes set-fallback --route=completion --model=redwood-small-quant --duration=30m` and re-seed caches. Also notify customers.

maria: Plan updated: window shifted to 03:45-05:45 UTC. Exclude Dedicated/reserved pools, disable cluster-autoscaler during drains, seed prefix cache pre-drain, canary validation after each rack. I'll post live status to #eng-oncall and this thread. Please ack. :thumbsup:

oncall-night: Ack — will monitor and be available. Please ping if ACME job changes. :white_check_mark:

ashok: :thumbsup: also adding a short note to SRE runbook about autoscaler disable/reenable steps.

tess: I'll be online for the whole window and will paste smoke outputs here.

maria: Thanks team — starting prep at 02:30 UTC (cache seeding + preflight). Final runbook in MNT-2026-1432.
